articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Video, and 3D
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, which introduces unified multimodal reasoning that can jointly process code repositories, video streams, and 3D scene data in a single context window. Benchmarks show a 40% improvement in complex multi-step planning tasks over GPT-5's initial release. The model is available via API with a 1M-token context window and significantly reduced latency compared to its predecessor.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves Breakthrough on ARC-AGI-2 Benchmark
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2 has scored 91% on the ARC-AGI-2 benchmark, a significant leap in abstract reasoning capability that approaches human-level performance on novel problem types. The achievement leverages a new architecture called Adaptive Compute Graphs that dynamically allocates inference-time compute to harder sub-problems. Researchers caution this doesn't equate to AGI but marks a notable milestone in generalizable reasoning.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Supervised Deployment in Amazon Fulfillment Centers
articles.summary: Amazon confirmed a pilot program deploying 1,000 Tesla Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robots across five U.S. fulfillment centers for pick-and-pack operations, supervised by human operators at a 1:10 ratio. Early data suggests a 25% throughput increase for mixed-SKU handling compared to existing robotic arms. The partnership signals growing confidence in general-purpose humanoid platforms for real-world logistics at scale.

articles.title: Figure AI Demonstrates Fully Autonomous Kitchen Workflow with Figure 03 Robot
articles.summary: Figure AI released a demo showing its Figure 03 humanoid robot completing a 45-minute multi-course meal preparation entirely autonomously, including tool use, heat management, and plating. The system combines a vision-language-action model with real-time tactile feedback for dexterous manipulation of kitchen utensils and fragile ingredients. The company says commercial availability for hospitality applications is targeted for Q2 2027.

articles.title: Anthropic Publishes Mechanistic Interpretability Framework That Maps Claude's Internal World Model
articles.summary: Anthropic released a landmark paper detailing a scalable mechanistic interpretability framework that identifies coherent world-model representations inside large transformer networks, tested on Claude 4. The work maps causal circuits responsible for spatial reasoning, temporal logic, and ethical deliberation, enabling targeted fine-tuning with far fewer failure modes. The framework is open-sourced and is already being adopted by alignment research labs worldwide.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm GAA Process Node for Next-Gen AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC announced volume production on its N1.4 process node using second-generation gate-all-around transistors, with NVIDIA and Broadcom confirmed as lead customers for AI accelerator chips. The node delivers a 30% power efficiency gain and 20% performance uplift over N2, critical for addressing data center energy constraints. First commercial chips on N1.4 are expected in products shipping by early 2027.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Useful Quantum Error Correction at 100 Logical Qubits
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum jointly demonstrated a 100-logical-qubit system with error rates below the threshold needed for practical quantum chemistry simulations, using Microsoft's topological qubit encoding scheme. The team ran a catalyst optimization simulation relevant to industrial ammonia synthesis that outperformed classical HPC baselines. This marks the first widely acknowledged instance of quantum advantage on a commercially relevant chemistry problem.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Electric Receives FDA Clearance for Assisted Patient Mobility in Hospitals
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics announced FDA 510(k) clearance for a healthcare-specific configuration of its electric Atlas humanoid robot designed to assist with patient transfers, mobility support, and equipment transport in hospital settings. The clearance follows an 18-month clinical trial across four U.S. hospital systems showing a 60% reduction in staff musculoskeletal injuries during patient handling. Deployment begins at partner institutions in Q1 2027 with full-time nursing staff oversight.
